source_text: Ceterae sortes maritimae et aquilonales. Dan ascendit in Lesem — ambulo quaerens ampliora. Varietas charismatum.
pass_a_gloss: Other lots maritime and northern. Dan goes-up into Leshem — I-walk seeking larger-things. Variety of-gifts.
pass_b_english: The remaining lots run seaward and north. [[Dan goes up to Leshem >> Bible:Joshua 19:47]] — walking to seek more room. A variety of gifts.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
